nom: Klairs Gentle Black Deep Cleansing Oil

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin mostly report it cleanses without irritation and can even reduce oiliness over time, though one with oily, breakout-prone skin had a bad reaction with new pimples and breakouts.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin describe it as hydrating and gentle, removing makeup without stripping the skin.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin, including some with eczema, consistently describe it as soothing and non-irritating.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin say it balances an oily T-zone while still being nourishing enough for drier areas.

concerns.blemishes: One reviewer with oily, breakout-prone skin reports significant new pimples and breakouts after using this oil, while several others with oily or acne-prone skin say it doesn't cause breakouts and even helps calm acne-prone skin.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers, including those with dry skin, say it cleanses without stripping moisture and leaves skin soft and hydrated afterward.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer with an oily T-zone reports a noticeable decrease in oil production with regular use.

aspects.libelle: Leaves an oily film unless double-cleansed
Removes waterproof makeup and sunscreen well
Reduces sebaceous filaments with longer massage
Pump can leak or arrive broken

extraits.texte: I was interested in oil cleansing and didn't know where to start. Skipping the chemistry lesson has made my face angry; I haven't had pimples and breakouts like this since my teens. First, I have combination leaning-oily skin prone to clogged pores, breakouts, and acne, which means I really needed something lower/noncomedogenic. This contains soybean and sesame oil, which don't always play nice with clogging pores. Application was very runny, but definitely felt effective at clearing sebaceous filaments. It didn't emulsify very well (tried a few different ways) and after rinsing for several min, I still felt oil. Didn't see a difference in breakouts with a double-cleanse. It smells nice? A very light, sweet scent.

I gave it 4 stars because whiles its good it just doesn't quite make me say "I love it!" I was looking for an cheaper alternative to Tatcha's Cleansing Oil. This one doesn't quite emulsify very well. And after rinsing twice, I feel the very soft slickness of oil on my face. I don't really like that and it's only gone after using my face wash. It does however remove my makeup very cleanly. I have oily skin so maybe that's why I'm sensitive to feeling more oil on my face.

extraits.titre: Wonderful cleansing oil for dry skin
extraits.texte: I've been using this for over a year and I love it. Takes off the most resistant makeup and sunscreen without leaving my skin stripped. I do double cleanse and use a creamy gentle cleanser afterwards. My skin type is dry leans dehydrated. Not prone to acne but I do have occasional clogged pores.

I was sceptical about using cleansing oils for a long time because of my somewhat oily acne prone skin, but I heard about the benefits of cleansing oils so I tried one from a different brand first and really hated it, as it left an annoying oily residue, even after a double cleanse. BUT I decided to give an oil another go and got this one because I generally enjoy klairs products. Thank goodness because I love this so muc and don't want to ever use anything but this one. It removes makeup well and I use it daily even if I am not wearing makeup because it removes sunscreen, dirt, and sweat from the day thoroughly. It has a very faint scent that I really like, but can't put my finger on what it is, but is nice and calming while massaging this into my skin. Upon emulsifying and rinsing off it doesn't leave my skin feeling heavy or oily at all, only soft and plump! I do always double cleanse after, but sometimes I don't even feel like I need to because my skin feels so nice after.

extraits.titre: So amazing even for very sensitive skin
extraits.texte: I've always had normal and healthy skin until I had impetigo which affected a huge part of my face, later on resulted in eczema. During my recent flare up, I could not use any of my usual cleansers, and this product really helped a great deal with my cleansing routine. It doesn't irritate at all, but surprisingly soothes my skin while cleansing it really well. Remember to emulsify the oil with lukewarm water for easier rinse off. The only minor setback for me is that it tends to clump up around the areas in between my nose and eyes. The quicker way for me to cleanse it off would be to use a gentle foaming cleanser just around the eye area. This is definitely something I will repurchase. It's so versatile, I also use it together with I'm From Fig Mask during the final scrubbing step for that extra deep cleansing. My pores are so clean! Highly recommend this.

I love this product for the summer time because I can put it directly on dry skin (per the directions) and get a really deep but gentle clean. I have oily /combination skin that gets tight and irritated with moist cleansers you find in US drug stores, but this stuff is FANTASTIC. You get a really effective clean without drying out the skin. I use this in conjunction with a gentle brush exfoliator or the black sugar scrub.
